app.name: Hololemma
landing.tagline: A holographic lab you control with your bare hands.
landing.subtitle: Take a human heart and a robot dog apart in mid-air, study every piece, then put them back together. All you need is a laptop webcam.
lab.privacy: Your camera stays on your device. Video is never uploaded or recorded.
lab.cameraDenied: Camera access was blocked. You can still explore with your mouse.
lab.cameraNotFound: No webcam found. You can still explore with your mouse.
lab.cameraUnsupported: This browser can't use the camera. Try Chrome or Edge on a laptop.
lab.cameraUnknown: The camera couldn't start. You can still explore with your mouse.
lab.unknownModel: This model isn't in the library yet.
